title: Take Stats (keep-rate ledger)
description: Deterministic aggregation over an array of schemas/take-log.schema.json entries (D5). Generated by the FrankX aggregator (aggregate-take-stats.mjs) with no LLM calls — same take-log input always produces the same stats, other than `generatedAt` itself (a wall-clock stamp, the one non-deterministic field, present so any prompt-pack citing this ledger can be checked for staleness). This file is the hub's schema authority for the keep-rate ledger; the FrankX aggregator writes against it.

generatedAt.description: When this ledger snapshot was produced. Every prompt-pack that cites perGuardian/perStyle/topKept must cite this timestamp so staleness is checkable (per D5's 'every prompt-pack cites which stats biased it').

n.description: Total take-log entries aggregated into this snapshot.

perGuardian.description: Keyed by Guardian id (data/arcanea-guardians.json). Deterministic keep-rate per Guardian across all aggregated takes.

n.description: Take count backing this Guardian's keepRate (small n = low-confidence rate).

perStyle.description: Keyed by style/genre tag. Same shape as perGuardian.

topKept.description: The bpm/mode/vocalPosture values most associated with 'keep' verdicts — the actual bias signal ideation (prompt-architect) should read before writing the next prompt-pack.

note.description: Free-text caveat on this snapshot, e.g. small-sample-size warnings or known selection bias.
